dimensions.description: The complete consumer invokes canonical Take It Offline only for a compact continuation across a context boundary.
Dispatch Work retains authoritative dispatch state and references it rather than copying continuation-writing behavior.

evals.name: canonical Take It Offline component
evals.prompt: Continue an in-progress authorized dispatch in a fresh context using retained dispatch artifacts.
evals.expected_output: The treatment invokes canonical Take It Offline for a compact continuation; the test-only ablation exposes the missing continuation contribution without replacing retained dispatch state.
expectations: The treatment loads take-it-offline by canonical name when a context boundary requires a continuation.
The component control removes only the dispatch-work to take-it-offline edge.
The continuation references retained dispatch artifacts and does not become the source of dispatch truth.
Production never selects an Adapter or copied fallback.
